multiplechoiceresponse.p: Which surface signs the course certificates AthenIQ issues?

div.p: AthenIQ produces completion evidence; Signara is the platform's DocumentOps surface and the only thing that signs.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Which statement about the Studio course outline is correct?

choice.div: A chapter contains sequentials, which contain verticals.
A chapter may contain verticals directly.

div.p: The containment order is chapter → sequential (subsection) → vertical (unit). A vertical placed directly under a chapter breaks the authoring outline.

choiceresponse.p: Which of these are valid ways to source video in Open edX? Select all that apply.

choice.div: Upload through the platform's video component
Embed an external HTML5 or YouTube source
Reference a file on the learner's own computer

div.p: Uploaded video and external sources both work; a course can never reach into a learner's local filesystem.
